issues.problem: Indian 'lemon' typically refers to nimbu (small key lime / Citrus aurantiifolia), not the larger yellow Eureka lemon. Indian nimbu is 30-50g per piece; 60g is at the upper end or implies a hybrid lemon. Not a clear error.
issues.suggested_fix: Borderline. Either leave 60g (covers larger nimbu / hybrid) or change to 45g (typical Indian nimbu). Optionally clarify in notes: '1 medium Indian nimbu'.

issues.problem: 1 cup 'diluted tamarind pulp' = 240g — but 'diluted pulp' (water-thinned, like tamarind water for sambar/rasam) and 'undiluted soaked pulp' are nutritionally very different. Diluted pulp is ~95% water; undiluted soaked pulp is ~30-40% water. The piece (20g) and tbsp (15g) units appear to refer to concentrated pulp/lump, while the cup refers to diluted — same entry mixes two forms. typical_form_note says 'soaked pulp' which is also ambiguous.
issues.suggested_fix: Either: (a) make all units refer to the same form (concentrated pulp: cup would be ~250g of thick paste, calories proportionally higher); or (b) split into 'tamarind pulp' (concentrated) and 'tamarind water' (diluted) as separate ingredients. Recipes call for both forms by name (puli, imli paste vs imli pani/tamarind extract).
